_comment: MERGE with any existing file rather than overwriting; union the deny arrays.
Remove the _comment/_notes keys before committing — Claude Code tolerates
them but they are noise in a checked-in config.
Rule syntax: Bash(cmd:*) is prefix matching — the colon before * matters;
a bare trailing * matches nothing at all.
The daemon runs with --permission-mode acceptEdits, which auto-approves
file edits. Bash commands NOT in allow are auto-DENIED in headless runs
(there is nobody to answer a prompt), so every command the agent needs —
including this project's test/lint/build commands — must be listed in
allow. Deny always wins over allow.
_notes: git push is DENIED here on purpose: the daemon pushes, not the agent.
That keeps one writer to the remote and makes force-push impossible to reach.
Workflow files are denied because an agent that can edit .github/workflows/
can grant itself CI privileges you did not intend.
Deny rules are prefix-only; piped/obfuscated commands can't be pattern-
matched — headless default-deny is the real backstop.
Add your own project-specific denies: migration runners, seed scripts,
anything that touches a shared staging database.
